headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: VER (8)

summary: Sergio Perez won the Saudi Arabian Grand Prix from pole position, 5.4s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Fernando Alonso completing the podium.
Max Verstappen made the biggest climb, from P15 to P2.
Oscar Piastri had a day to forget, dropping from P8 to P15.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised ALO (5 second time penalty) and ALO (10 second time penalty).
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 1 points over Sergio Perez.
